title: Stability has fallen from 34 to 7 since May 1343: the reforms of the Jamāʿa remake the state while the debt chips away at the crown's authority

data.cause: the Jamāʿa's reforms of 1344 (Distribution of Power, royal harem) and the debt to the estates

source: checkpoint 1345-01-27; the cause is Trent's account

title: Six more estate loans repaid: the debt is down to 288 ducats, with a surplus of 9 a month
Sovereignty stands at 50.15, the barest margin above the line; influence is almost at the middle of the channel, −3.6
The Ṭāʾifa of Balansiyya is now a loyal subject; Mursiyya, at 35, is still disloyal
Najīb of the ʿulamāʾ, a man of rare gifts, is at court
Balansiyya now 80,000 Muslims to 101,000 Christians; Mursiyya two-thirds Muslim
A Naṣrid betrothal is agreed with the Ḥafṣids of Tunis
A second betrothal is agreed, with Ghana beyond the desert
